tooltips.datasetName: A unique identifier for your dataset. Must be unique across all datasets, case-insensitive. Maximum length: 128 characters.
tooltips.description: A brief description of what this dataset contains or its purpose. Maximum length: 65535 characters.
tooltips.embeddingModel: The embedding model used to convert text into vector representations. Select from OpenAI models: text-embedding-3-large, text-embedding-3-small, or text-embedding-ada-002.
tooltips.permission: Access control for the dataset. 'Me' means only you can access it, 'Team' allows team members to access it.
tooltips.chunkMethod: The method used to split documents into chunks. Different methods are optimized for different document types (e.g., 'Naive' for general documents, 'Book' for books, 'Email' for emails).
tooltips.chunkTokenNum: The number of tokens per chunk. Controls how much text is included in each chunk. Range: 1-2048 tokens. Default: 512.
tooltips.delimiter: The character(s) used to separate chunks. Default is newline (\n). You can use any delimiter string.
tooltips.autoKeywords: Automatically extract keywords from chunks. Range: 0-32 keywords per chunk. Set to 0 to disable.
tooltips.autoQuestions: Automatically generate questions from chunks. Range: 0-10 questions per chunk. Set to 0 to disable.
tooltips.taskPageSize: Number of pages to process at once for PDF documents. Minimum: 1. Default: 12. Only applies to PDF files.
tooltips.layoutRecognize: The layout recognition engine to use. Currently only 'DeepDOC' is supported.
tooltips.html4excel: Convert Excel files to HTML format before processing. Useful for preserving Excel formatting and structure.

tooltips.name: A unique name for your chat assistant. This will be displayed to users when they interact with the assistant.
tooltips.description: A brief description of what this chat assistant does or its purpose. Helps users understand when to use this assistant.
tooltips.avatar: Select an avatar/icon to represent this chat assistant. The avatar will be displayed in chat interfaces and lists.
tooltips.datasetIds: Select one or more datasets that this chat assistant will use as its knowledge base. The assistant will search through these datasets to answer questions.
tooltips.modelName: The language model to use for generating responses. Different models have different capabilities, speeds, and costs. Select from OpenAI models like GPT-3.5, GPT-4, GPT-4 Turbo, etc.
tooltips.reasoning: Enable advanced reasoning capabilities. When enabled, the model will use more sophisticated reasoning processes, which may improve answer quality but increase response time and cost.
tooltips.temperature: Controls the randomness of responses. Lower values (0-0.5) make responses more focused and deterministic. Higher values (1-2) make responses more creative and varied. Range: 0-2. Default: 0.1.
tooltips.topP: Controls diversity via nucleus sampling. Lower values focus on more likely tokens. Higher values allow more diverse responses. Range: 0-1. Default: 0.3.
tooltips.presencePenalty: Penalizes tokens that have appeared in the text so far, encouraging new topics. Negative values encourage repetition. Range: -2 to 2. Default: 0.4.
tooltips.frequencyPenalty: Penalizes tokens based on their frequency in the text so far. Higher values reduce repetition. Range: -2 to 2. Default: 0.7.
tooltips.similarityThreshold: Minimum similarity score required for a chunk to be included in the response. Lower values include more chunks (may be less relevant). Higher values include only highly relevant chunks. Range: 0-1. Default: 0.2.
tooltips.keywordsSimilarityWeight: Weight given to keyword matching vs semantic similarity. Higher values prioritize keyword matches. Lower values prioritize semantic meaning. Range: 0-1. Default: 0.7.
tooltips.topN: Maximum number of chunks to retrieve from the knowledge base for each query. More chunks provide more context but may include irrelevant information. Range: 1-50. Default: 6.
tooltips.topK: Maximum number of tokens to consider when ranking chunks. Higher values consider more context but are slower. Range: 1-2048. Default: 1024.
tooltips.keywordAnalysis: Enable keyword extraction and analysis. When enabled, the system will extract and analyze keywords from queries and documents to improve matching.
tooltips.showQuote: Whether to show source quotes in responses. When enabled, the assistant will cite specific passages from the knowledge base.
tooltips.crossLanguages: Select languages that the assistant should handle. The assistant will be able to understand and respond in these languages, even if the query is in a different language.
tooltips.opener: The initial greeting message shown when a user starts a new conversation with this assistant.
tooltips.emptyResponse: The message shown when no relevant content is found in the knowledge base for a user's query.
tooltips.systemPrompt: The system prompt that defines the assistant's behavior, personality, and instructions. This guides how the assistant responds to queries.
